repo.description:
### Impact

An accidental left in place development file of a dependency allowed an attacker, that is able to upload files on the same server, to perform a cross-site scripting attack.

### Patches

It is recommended that the Nextcloud Server is upgraded to 30.0.17, 31.0.10 or 32.0.1
It is recommended that the Nextcloud Enterprise Server is upgraded to 22.2.10.33, 23.0.12.29, 24.0.12.28, 25.0.13.23, 26.0.13.20, 27.1.11.20, 28.0.14.11, 29.0.16.8, 30.0.17, 31.0.10 or 32.0.1

### Workarounds

* Remove `apps/files_pdfviewer/js/pdfjs/web/viewer.html` manually

### References

* Reported by: [RedTeam Pentesting](https://www.redteam-pentesting.de/)
* [PullRequest](https://github.com/nextcloud/files_pdfviewer/pull/1275)

### For more information

If you have any questions or comments about this advisory:

* Create a post in [nextcloud/security-advisories](https://github.com/nextcloud/security-advisories/discussions)
* Customers: Open a support ticket at [portal.nextcloud.com](https://portal.nextcloud.com)
repo.summary: Development files shipped in files_pdfviewer app
